1.web: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
1.asv: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.

2.web: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
2.asv: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.

3.web: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
3.asv: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.

4.web: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.
4.asv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed as with the drought of summer. [Selah

5.web: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
5.asv: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. [Selah

6.web: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.
6.asv: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.

7.web: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.
7.asv: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. [Selah

8.web: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
8.asv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.

9.web: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
9.asv: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, Elsethey will not come near unto thee.

10.web: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
10.asv: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he that trusteth in Jehovah, lovingkindness shall compass him about.

11.web: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
11.asv: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
